styleSuffix: Flat geometric editorial illustration, minimal, generous negative space, off-white background (#f7f7f5), near-black ink (#0e0f12) linework, accent colors limited to: lime (#d8f15b), deep orchid (#853a78), blue (#3150c8). No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no realistic human faces.

images.prompt: Dozens of scattered calendar meeting blocks drifting across the canvas, gradually converging into one small glowing lime block on the right; a sense of calm order emerging from clutter.

Split composition. Left half: a crowded meeting table with eight abstract geometric figures hunched around it, muted neutral tones, dense and heavy. Right half: three abstract geometric figures gathered around a single bright card with a lime accent, airy, light, spacious.

A messy stack of overlapping documents on the left being sorted by abstract geometric arms into three tidy, neatly aligned option cards on the right; blue accent lines indicating verified facts flowing from documents to cards.
Two abstract stamps entering from opposite edges of the frame, one deep orchid and one blue, pressing together onto one shared card in the center; perfect symmetry, a feeling of mutual agreement.
A single receipt-like card held taut in the middle between two abstract geometric buildings on opposite sides; thin lines connect both buildings to the card; balance, neutrality, trust.
A bold lime check mark stamped over a calendar date tile, with one thin blue line tracing back to a small record card in the corner; a sense of verification and quiet completion.
A single small lime square centered in generous off-white negative space, with one subtle radiating outline around it; quiet, complete, final.
